bio: Hey, my name is Gianna. I am a junior electrical engineering major. I run long distance events, including the 3k, 5k, and 3k Steeplechase. I enjoy listening to music, baking, and hanging with friends.

A shot putter through and through. A modern-day Renaissance man. Not only is he an athlete, but he also fancies himself a photographer, often found behind the camera—whether at practice, meets, on-campus cultural events, or fashion shows. Thoughtful, talented, and thorough—he is Nhyiraba “Kojo” Asumadu Addo.
I am a CS grad student and studied QF in undergrad. I am from South Jersey and like to watch sports.

Hi I'm Cate Bondi! I am from Irondequoit, New York. I run XC and distance and steeple on the track. I love going for short swims during my races. I can do a Rubik's in a moderately impressive amount of time. I also enjoy singing with friends.
Hey! I'm Kate. My running events are the 400 and 800m. Outside of running, my hobbies include hiking, biking, and TIKTOK. Also, fun fact: I've competed in the world championships for cheerleading.
I'm a visual arts/technology major and run mid-distance (800-3K). KT Tape's #1 fan and head chef at Papa's Susheria.
awards: 2024 YMCA J. Barry Stanford Special Achievement

bio: World's biggest Sonic fan, professional at napping, and still 1-0 to Enrico on the track.

Hi, I'm Matt Hods. I am a mid distance runner and my favorite event is the 800. I am part of the greatest lineage on the team. Outside of running, I am a slightly avid juggler and a more avid guitar player.
I'm a multi - my favorite event switches between pole vault and javelin depending on the day - and I'm a Mechanical Engineering major.

Hey!! I'm Lillian, a first-year Business and Technology major with a passion for both academics and athletics. As a thrower for my college Track & Field team, I will be throwing all the throwing events, but my main focus is on Javelin and Discus. When I'm not on the field, you can usually find me out in nature, enjoying a good walk and taking in the scenery. Creativity is also a big part of my life; I love sketching, painting, and finding new ways to express myself artistically.
Hi I'm Kevin! I am a Chemistry undergrad student from Fair Haven, New Jersey. I like food. I have a pet fish named Dale.
Big 5k-10k guy. Dabble in some 3k. Upcoming 800m champ.

I am a middle distance runner. I played basketball throughout most of high school, and stopped during my junior year to start running track. I started distance running with cross country my senior year, as I sprinted and jumped during my junior year.
awards: High School - NJ State Champ in the 4x800
High School - State Sectional Champ in the 3200m
High School - League Champ in the 1600m

bio: Hi I'm Breona! I am a computer science major with an interest in AI and machine learning. I started track and field my freshman year of high school right before covid. Since then I have been high jumping and starting to do throws as well!

Maggie is a jumper, specializing in high jump. She is majoring in biology on the pre-veterinary track. In her free time, Maggie likes to bring her dog Moose to the dog park and try new coffee shops around Hoboken.

Hi, I'm Anya! I'm from Parsippany, NJ. I run cross country and run sprints/hurdles during the track seasons. I love running full speed at stationary objects during my races. I can do a Rubik's cube in a slightly more than moderately impressive time. I also enjoy singing (preferably alone).
The day you see my mustache come off is the day I stop running.
